verdict.rationale: Pilot says customers switching providers get onboarding from a dedicated accountant (pilot-docs-1, pilot-docs-19), and that you can keep your existing QuickBooks account and historical data (pilot-docs-2). That covers founders already on QuickBooks, but nothing describes an actual migration process from other accounting systems or confirms that transaction-level detail survives. Missing for 10: documented migration from non-QuickBooks systems, explicit preservation of transaction-level detail, a description of the migration process, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a migration.
